catalogue.note: The redesigned Home. Drawn in Figma at 0.75 of real size (270×600; instances carry scaleFactor 0.75): built at 360×800 with every value divided by 0.75, which lands the type on 24/14/12/11/10, margins on 24, list rows on 72 with 16 padding and 12 radius, the button on 40. Square-cornered: the frame’s own 12px corners are left off and the diff leaves the four corners out. Auto-layout frames are flex with Figma’s direction, gap, padding and alignment. The balance is Satoshi Black with the #FF7500 to #FF9000 gradient run over its 32px line box; the button carries the same gradient. Satoshi has no ₦ (U+20A6) in the files on this Mac (431 glyphs); in Figma the sign is drawn at each weight with its own outline (0.552em wide, advance 0.572em, read off Figma’s glyph positions): each one here is Figma’s outline for that weight, inline. The naira sign in the Nigerian Naira circle is a text layer too (Medium, 20px at Figma’s scale): Figma’s outline, with the circle. The navbar’s top line is a 2px outside stroke, #696969 at 4%, multiplied. Status bar, bottom bar and every icon are Figma’s SVG export of the vectors, unchanged. Type is live Satoshi from the files on this Mac, embedded whole. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own 0.75 scale and Chrome floors its own at this one: the type styles where the two land apart carry the difference as a sub-pixel offset, so at 3× every string sits on Figma’s baseline (0px off, all strings measured) and at 1× within a third of a pixel, except 16px labels, which sit two thirds high. What is left in the diff is glyph and curve antialiasing; flat fills match exactly.
